newsitem.title: USA: PAR Technology expects Q1 loss.
newsitem.headline: PAR Technology expects Q1 loss.

text.p: PAR Technology Corp said on Wednesday that it expects a first quarter loss per share in the $0.22 to $0.26 range, due to product delays hurting revenues.
In last year's first quarter, the company reported earnings per share of $0.07.
Securities analysts were expecting the company to earn about $0.08 a share in the first quarter, according to First Call's consensus of earnings estimates.
PAR said it expects revenues for the first quarter ended March 31, 1997 to be in a range of $16.5 million to $17.5 million, compared with $25.5 million in the first quarter 1996.
Final financial results for PAR's first fiscal quarter ending March 31, 1997 are expected to be released April 16, 1997, the company said.
